prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light in Conroe, Texas, waiting to make a turn, when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was hard enough to jolt me forward and then back against the seat. I got out and spoke with the other driver, who confirmed that he had not been able to stop in time. Since the accident, I have felt stiffness and pain in my neck and upper back, which I believe is whiplash. Over the following days I remembered a few more details, such as the sound of brakes just before impact, but my core description of what happened has not changed since I first reported it. I am the named driver on this policy and I am providing this account so the claim can be processed.
